integrity: A theorem with complete analytic proof and bounded finite numerical corroboration; no finite test is used as proof of an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Complex-analytic germs of the specified complete-intersection family only; historical priority of the precise conductor partitions provisional. The cited preprint was first made public April 7, 2026, but its Pfister-Schönemann family application appears in the November 4, 2026 revision. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Conductor multidegrees and parity of the Pfister–Schönemann curve germs
